components.name: Text Input Card
components.description: Surface card with visible label and editable textarea.
components.css: .ds-input{font-family:"IBM Plex Sans Thai","IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif;border-radius:16px;background:var(--surface);padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;}.ds-input label{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;font-weight:500;}.ds-input textarea{font-family:"IBM Plex Sans Thai","IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif;width:100%;min-height:144px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);resize:vertical;font-size:16px;line-height:24px;border-radius:4px;}.ds-input textarea::placeholder{color:var(--muted);}.ds-input textarea:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Four equal icon and Thai-label columns.
components.html: หน้าหลักตรวจสอบรายงานประวัติ
components.css: .ds-nav{font-family:"IBM Plex Sans Thai","IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif;min-height:88px;padding:12px 12px 16px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));background:#fff;}.ds-nav-item{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;min-height:60px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;align-items:center;padding:4px;border-radius:12px;font-size:12px;line-height:18px;}.ds-nav-item.ds-active{color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;}.ds-nav-item:hover{background:var(--surface);}.ds-nav-item:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Source Card
components.description: Contextual university source, not a sender-verification claim.
components.html: ข้อมูลมหาวิทยาลัยที่ใกล้เคียงข้อมูลทุนการศึกษาchula.ac.th · อ่านแหล่งอ้างอิง ↗
components.css: .ds-source{font-family:"IBM Plex Sans Thai","IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif;border-radius:16px;background:var(--surface);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink);padding:16px;transition:background .15s;}.ds-source small{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);}.ds-source strong{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;}.ds-source span{font-size:13px;line-height:20px;font-weight:500;color:var(--accent);}.ds-source:hover{background:#f0e7ec;}.ds-source:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Category Row
components.description: Report category opens the corresponding mock pattern guide.
components.css: .ds-category{font-family:"IBM Plex Sans Thai","IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;min-height:48px;width:100%;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s;}.ds-category>span:first-child{flex:1;}.ds-category strong{font-family:"IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:600;}.ds-category:hover{background:#f0e5ea;}.ds-category:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:4px;}

narrative.overview:
Preserve the supplied mobile Figma world: a quiet Thai student safety tool with white surfaces, pink identity, compact cards and clear next actions. The implemented interface pairs concise Thai copy with IBM Plex typography and uses semantic green or danger red to distinguish mock findings.

This document records the implemented source, not a redesign. The supplied Figma file remains visual authority. Analysis, notifications, statistics and university connections are simulations; their visual presentation must keep that status legible.
keyCharacteristics: A 390px mobile composition with 24px content gutters.
Soft rectangular surfaces, mostly 16px corners, with little structural shadow.
Thai-first typography, deep pink actions and explicit simulated-data labels.
dos: Do preserve the supplied Figma composition and concise Thai voice.
Do use deep pink for primary actions and pink for brand marks and selected chart bars.
Do keep mock-analysis labels, uncertainty copy and contextual source links visible.
Do retain keyboard focus indicators and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don’t widen desktop into a new dashboard layout.
Don’t present mock scores, source matches or report totals as verified findings.
Don’t use green alone to communicate a safe state; retain text and icons.
Don’t add decorative gradients or structural card shadows to the established flat surfaces.
